verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Workers serving HTTP apps and APIs, and it mentions WebSockets, including billing for hibernating WebSockets and Agents' real-time communication. Nothing shows inbound TCP or gRPC serving, or that all four protocols run from one service without separate configuration. An older community comment also describes WebSockets as beta. Missing for 10: inbound TCP serving, gRPC serving, evidence of unified multi-protocol handling without per-protocol configuration, and current hands-on WebSocket corroboration.
